title: Independent coordinate decomposition
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $\rho\in[-1,1]$. For a correlated pair $(X,Y)$ of sign vectors in $\{\pm1\}^n$, formed by choosing $X$ uniformly and applying independent coordinate noise with retention probability $(1+\rho)/2$, rearrange the pair as $((X_i,Y_i))_{i=1}^n$. Its law is the product of $n$ copies of the law of a single sign pair formed by choosing the first sign uniformly from $\{\pm1\}$ and applying the same noise rule to obtain the second.
